name: default lyric
text:
I keep the porch light on
for you to-night
the road is long and the night is cold

and every mile I wait for you
counting the cars that pass me by

so come on home
come on home to me
so come on home
I'll be wait-ing up

the kettle hums the clock is slow
I read your letters by the door

and every mile I wait for you
counting the cars that pass me by

so come on home
come on home to me
so come on home
I'll be wait-ing up

maybe the light was never for you
maybe I left it on for me

so come on home
come on home to me
so come on home
I'll be wait-ing up

leave the light on
